parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title, p.language, s.id AS scene_id, s.scene_number, s.title AS scene_title, s.summary, s.emotional_tone, s.production_metadata, s.characters_present FROM projects p JOIN scenes s ON p.id = s.project_id WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.state IN ('planned', 'shot_planned', 'fight_choreographed') ORDER BY s.scene_number
UPDATE scenes SET emotion_cinematography = $2::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
UPDATE projects SET emotion_directed = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'emotion_direction_complete', $2::jsonb, NOW())
